SCHEDULE A (DESCRIPTION) ALL that certain plot, piece or parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon erected, situate, lying and being in the Borough and County of Queens, City and State of New York, known and designated as Lots numbered 1423 and 1424 on a certain map entitled "Hitchcock's Second Plan of Homes for the People of West Flushing", filed in the Office of the Clerk of Queens County on April 14th, 1871 as Map No. 72, and also Lots numbered 413 and 414 on a certain map entitled "Hitchcock's Second Map of Corona Park" filed in the said Queens County Clerk's Office on October 28th, 1887 as map Number 377, which said lots, taken together, are more particularly bounded and described according to said map as follows: BEGINNING at a point on the northerly side of Alstyne Avenue (formerly known as Washington Avenue) distant 425 feet easterly from the corner formed by the intersection of the northerly side of Alstyne Avenue and the easterly side of 104th Street (formerly Sycamore Avenue and Christie Street); RUNNING THENCE northerly and at right angles to Alstyne Avenue, 100 feet; THENCE easterly and parallel with Alstyne Avenue, 50 feet; THENCE southerly again at right angles to Alstyne Avenue, 100 feet to the northerly side of Alstyne Avenue; THENCE westerly along the said northerly side of Alstyne Avenue, 50 feet to the point or placeofBEGINNING.
